typecheck.describe: tsc across all workspaces. The first thing to run after touching types.

lint_css.describe: stylelint over the frontend stylesheets: the CSS-only rules ESLint does not see.

test_full.describe: The full workspace suites, including the slower tiers the default `test` skips.

test_storybook.describe: The storybook Vitest project: every story's state set renders.

format_check.describe: prettier --check. It prints one line per unformatted file, so only the final count is kept - and CRLF noise is not a defect.

build.describe: tsc -b plus the vite build across the workspaces. This IS the frontend type-check; the frontend has no separate typecheck script.

format.describe: prettier --write across the workspaces. The write form of format:check - it rewrites files rather than failing on them.

design_audit.describe: Spine's design-audit via tools/design-audit-foundation.mjs --full: the design-system compliance audit, every rule. Floor 250/436/686 (S3, 2026-10-24).

design_audit_foundation.describe: Spine's design-audit, page-anatomy family only: the foundation gate that fails on a page max-width, a hand-rolled centering wrapper, or a page-defined grid.

check_closure.describe: Custom-property closure: every var(--x) resolves to a declaration, with declared/referenced/dangling/cycles counters. Dangling must be 0.

check_registry_stories.describe: Every registry entry has a matching Storybook story.

check_page_inventory.describe: The page inventory matches the routes that exist.

check_design_parity.describe: Design parity across the surfaces that must agree.

check_spine_parity.describe: Name discipline: the globals.css class names against the spine snapshot.

check_class_catalog.describe: The generated class catalog against the three stylesheets. A class added by hand is a finding.

check_module_boundaries.describe: Module-boundary violations (the architectural rule that is cheapest to check and most expensive to fix later).

check_system_map.describe: system-map.html is in sync with the repo (--check, so it reports and does not write).

check_doc_links.describe: No broken links in the docs tree.

check_load.describe: The rule-surface budget: always-on bytes and per-path fan-in against the ceilings in .github/agent-surface.json.

check_solar_parity.describe: Every gate in the workflow table resolves and has a solar command that runs it, and every registry agent has an agent file.

validate_radical_content.describe: Radical content data validates against its schema and invariants.

validate_grammar_content.describe: Grammar content data validates against its schema and invariants.

validate_chengyu_content.describe: Chengyu content data validates against its schema and invariants.

git_head.describe: Current HEAD commit - cite this when reporting what you read.

git_status.describe: Working-tree changes, so a report can separate your edits from what was already there.

git_diff.describe: A stat summary of uncommitted changes.
